transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I've been feeling deeply depressed, sad, and just completely empty inside for over a year now. I decided to come in because I just can't shake this heavy feeling anymore. It has been like this almost every day for about thirteen months.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the opposite—extremely happy, full of energy, or hyperactive, and needed much less sleep than usual?
No, I've never had times like that. I've mostly just felt really down, depressed, and completely empty inside. It has just been a constant heavy feeling without any of those high-energy moments.

{
  "category": "differential_point",
  "subcategory": "duration_and_continuity",
  "question": "During these past 13 months, have there been

No, there haven't been any times where I felt back to normal; it has been completely continuous for the whole thirteen months. I've also noticed that any strange experiences, like hearing things or having odd thoughts, only happen when I am in this deeply depressed state.
Could you tell me more about these strange experiences, such as what kinds of things you hear or what those odd thoughts are about?

I hear whispering voices when I'm completely alone, saying awful things about me that no one else can hear. I also get terrified because it constantly feels like people are watching me or secretly talking about me wherever I go. It's really frightening, and it only seems to happen when my depression is at its absolute worst.

{
  "category": "symptom_presence",
  "subcategory": "suicidal_ideation",
  "question": "Given how heavy and frightening things have been, have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or that

Yes, I've had thoughts of wanting to die, and there are days when I just wish I wouldn't wake up because everything feels so heavy. But even though I have those thoughts, I don't have any specific plan or intention to actually hurt myself.
Have you ever had a period of two weeks or more where you heard those whispering voices or felt watched, but your mood was actually fine and you weren't feeling depressed?

No, never. Those voices and the feeling of being watched only happen when I am at my absolute lowest and deeply depressed. If my mood is even slightly okay, those strange experiences don't happen at all.
